resources.string: A sly duel of shoves on a 5×5 board
Tap a circle to pick an avatar from the gallery. Long-press to reset.
First blood — lose one piece and you lose
To the last — you lose when all your pieces are gone

Goal: shove your opponent's pieces off the 5×5 board.

SETUP
Players take turns placing their pieces (2 or 3, per settings). You may not place on the edge, in the center, on an occupied cell, or — in the classic 2-piece game — in the same row or column as an enemy piece. If that last rule ever leaves no legal cell, it is lifted automatically.

A TURN = TWO ACTIONS
• Action 1 — move one of your pieces 1 cell horizontally or vertically.
• Action 2 — move a DIFFERENT piece, use one ability, or end the turn.
If you have only one piece left, it may move twice.

SHOVING
Moving into an occupied cell pushes the whole chain of pieces by 1 — friend or foe. A piece pushed over the edge is out. Careful: you can shove your own piece off too!

ABILITIES (second action only; using one ends your turn)
• Dash — one of your pieces moves 2 cells in a straight line, shoving everything in its way. Recharge: 3 turns.
• Swap — swap one of your pieces with any other piece. Recharge: 4.
• Shift — slide an entire row or column by 1. Pieces at the far edge fall off. Recharge: 4.
• Anchor — one of your pieces becomes immovable until your next turn: it can't be shoved, swapped or shifted, and it blocks shoves and shifts through its line. Recharge: 3.

VICTORY
«First blood» — the opponent loses one piece. «To the last» — the opponent loses all pieces. If one action knocks out pieces of both players, the acting player wins.
No legal cell — the «not in line with an enemy» rule is lifted
